conbody.p: Top gaps, beside the sections, lists the first few artifacts that need attention, worst first — failing requirements, then those without a verification method, without a test case, and so on — each with the reason. All opens the full list, grouped by kind of gap (for example requirements without a verification method, or without any verifying test). An empty list means full coverage. When agents have proposals waiting, the card says how many and links to them.

Otherwise the card ends in Draft tests. It opens the V&V Assistant over the page and starts at once: the assistant is given the gaps the card shows (all of them while All is open), each by reference, title and kind of gap, and the chat says so — Drafting test cases for 5 gaps: REQ-153, REQ-88, …. It replies with test cases, each with a verifies link, as suggestion cards you review and add. Pointing at a gap row shows a ✦ at its end (on a touch screen it is always there), which does the same for that one gap. If no runner is online, the chat says so and how to connect one; your request is kept and answered when one connects. On a workspace still on an earlier release, the card points you to the agents that can draft test cases instead.

Unverified (demonstration, analysis, inspection) is the section for requirements whose method is not test: nothing links a test case to them, so they can never show up as "without a test case". They stay listed until the requirement is marked verified, which is the same point at which the coverage rollup turns them from uncovered into verified-manually.
